g.text: Sylvera, BeZero and Calyx grade carbon projects, behind paywalls. CarbonPlan publishes open research but does
not grade companies. Climate TRACE estimates emissions only.
Netra grades the claim a company makes, free, with every source linked and every check on the record.
Proof points: 876 Mt retired since 2020 checked; 44,465 buyers; primary-source emissions for 79 of 94 classified
